name: Clamor Lycanis
detailed_description:
Clamor Lycanis is a first-person horror game set in the restricted outer grounds of a medical institute, hidden deep in the woods. You play as someone searching for a missing loved one — a researcher who once worked there, studying porphyria. After weeks of silence, a cryptic letter leads you to the edge of the fenced zone. The main building is locked, but scattered structures remain — and something still moves between them.

Key Features

  • Light-Based Survival:
    Use your flashlight carefully — it repels some threats, provokes others, and may reveal what you’re not ready to see.

  • Psychological Horror:
    Find scattered documents from former staff as you slowly unravel the truth behind the facility and your loved one’s fate.

  • Exploration-Driven Narrative:
    Discover key locations and notes that guide your path, gradually building a mysterious and unsettling backstory.

  • Pepper Spray Defense:
    Carry a limited-use pepper spray to temporarily fend off hostile wolf-like creatures. Use it wisely — resources are scarce.

  • Immersive Atmosphere:
    Designed with a found-footage bodycam aesthetic and an eerie soundscape to keep you tense and alert throughout.

short_description: After a cryptic letter, you cross the fence into the restricted grounds of a secluded medical institute. Explore abandoned research outposts in the forest, where wolves attack any light. Uncover clues to your missing loved one—and the dark force that lurks in the shadows.
